'''Dean Donny Huijsen Wijsmuller''' ({{IPA|es|ˈdiŋ ˈxawsen|lang}},<ref>{{cite tweet|user=RMadridInfo|author=Real Madrid Info|number=1922791884058996970|title=Dean Huijsen about how he prefers his name to be pronounced|accessdate=16 May 2025|language=es}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=10 April 2025 |title=LOS AMIGOS DE EDU {{!}} DEAN HUIJSEN {{!}} ENTREVISTA COMPLETA |trans-title=EDU'S FRIENDS {{!}} DEAN HUIJSEN {{!}} FULL INTERVIEW |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oEuiYYrJm8M&t=33s |access-date=21 September 2026 |website=[[YouTube]] |language=es|publisher=Chiringuito Inside}}</ref> {{IPA|nl|ˈdiːn ˈɦœy.sə(n)|lang}}; born 14 April 2005) is a professional [[association football|footballer]] who plays as a [[centre-back]] for {{Spanish football updater|Real Madrid}} club [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]]. Born in the Netherlands, he plays for the [[Spain national football team|Spain national team]].

Huijsen made his senior debut for [[Juventus FC|Juventus]]'s reserve team [[Juventus Next Gen]] in January 2023, and made his [[Serie A]] debut with the first team the following October. Following a loan spell at [[AS Roma|Roma]], Huijsen signed for [[Premier League]] side [[AFC Bournemouth|Bournemouth]] in July 2024. One year later in May 2025, he moved to La Liga club Real Madrid.

==Early life==
Huijsen was born in [[Amsterdam]] to {{interlanguage link|Donny Huijsen|nl}} and Macha Wijsmuller.<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":2">{{Cite web |date=26 August 2021 |title=Dean Huijsen treedt in de voetsporen van De Ligt: 'Het ging tussen Real en Juve' |url=https://www.voetbalzone.nl/doc.asp?uid=392842 |access-date=7 January 2023 |website=Voetbalzone |language=nl}}</ref> Donny played for [[Jong Ajax]] and had a professional career in the [[Eredivisie]] and the [[Eerste Divisie]].<ref name=":3" /><ref>{{Cite web |date=25 August 2021 |title=Nu blijkt dat zijn zoon Dean een supertalent is, moet ex-prof 'Maradonny' Huijsen zijn leven weer omgooien. Huijsen junior stapt over naar Juventus, het land van de topverdedigers [video] |url=https://www.noordhollandsdagblad.nl/cnt/dmf20210825_1663726 |access-date=7 January 2023 |website=www.noordhollandsdagblad.nl |language=nl-BE}}</ref><ref>{{Cite AV media |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?si=bWnvXhXbJqByYWE0&t=742&v=vLR6xlTt9Vs&feature=youtu.be |title=The Best is Yet to Come {{!}} Kenan Yildiz & Dean Huijsen {{!}} Juventus Creator Lab |date=19 December 2023 |last=Juventus |access-date=23 December 2024 |via=YouTube}}</ref> Dean can speak Dutch, Spanish, Italian and English.<ref>{{Cite AV media |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?si=C9tVxniXWHQOr9Jq&t=231&v=1PpUszFc1FM&feature=youtu.be |title="I can't wait to help the club progress!" {{!}} Dean Huijsen' first interview as an AFC Bournemouth man |date=31 July 2024 |last=AFC Bournemouth |access-date=26 December 2024 |via=YouTube}}</ref> The family relocated to [[Marbella]], Andalusia, Spain, when he was five years old; he became a Spanish citizen in February 2024.<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":1" /><ref name=":2" /><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.gazzetta.it/Calcio/Serie-A/Roma/21-02-2024/huijsen-e-diventato-spagnolo-ora-puo-essere-convocato-dalla-roja.shtml |publisher=La Gazzetta dello Sport |language=it |date=21 February 2024 |accessdate=21 February 2024 |title=Huijsen è diventato spagnolo: ora può essere convocato dalla Roja}}</ref> Huijsen's idol growing up was [[Sergio Ramos]].<ref>{{Cite AV media |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?si=3HcHda0pDNkWSwir&t=1278&v=alGsCojBbWI&feature=youtu.be |title=Talkin' Ballshit w/ Dean Huijsen |date=26 March 2025 |last=Papa Pincus |access-date=14 May 2025 |via=YouTube}}</ref>

==Club career==
===Early career===
Huijsen began playing with Costa Unida CF de Marbella before joining [[Málaga CF|Málaga]]'s youth set-up in 2015, at age 10.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |date=15 July 2021 |title=La Juventus compensará al Málaga por la contratación del excanterano Dean Huijsen |url=https://www.diariosur.es/malagacf/juventus-compensacion-malaga-fichaje-dean-huijsen-20210715154154-nt.html |access-date=7 January 2023 |website=Diario Sur |language=es}}</ref><ref name=":1">{{Cite web |last=Marín |first=Dani |date=5 May 2021 |title=La Juventus pesca en La Academia y ficha al cadete Dean Huijsen |url=https://www.eldesmarque.com/malaga/malaga-cf/malaga-noticias/258961-la-juventus-pesca-en-la-academia-y-ficha-al-cadete-dean-huijsen |access-date=7 January 2023 |website=ElDesmarque Málaga |language=es}}</ref>

===Juventus===
In May 2021, Huijsen joined [[Juventus FC|Juventus]], playing for their U17s.<ref name=":1" /><ref name=":3">{{Cite web |date=19 May 2022 |title=Huijsen (17) volgt vader 'Maradonny' op: 'Ik kan verleidingen beter weerstaan' |url=https://nos.nl/artikel/2429403-huijsen-17-volgt-vader-maradonny-op-ik-kan-verleidingen-beter-weerstaan |access-date=7 January 2023 |website=nos.nl |language=nl}}</ref> Ahead of the 2022–23 season, he moved up the U19s and he scored six goals in 14 matches until November 2022.<ref>Look at the list of matches played in [[Campionato Primavera 1]] and in the [[UEFA Youth League]] for the number of matches and goals in that range of time. {{WorldFootball.net|id=dean-huijsen}}</ref> He also featured in two first-team friendlies against [[Standard Liège]] and [[HNK Rijeka|Rijeka]] in December 2022.<ref name=":5">{{Cite web |date=16 June 2023 |title=Ufficiale {{!}} Dean Huijsen rinnova fino al 2027 |url=https://www.juventus.com/it/news/articoli/ufficiale-dean-huijsen-rinnova-fino-al-2027 |access-date=17 June 2023 |website=Juventus.com |language=it-IT}}</ref>

In early January 2023, Huijsen was promoted to [[Juventus Next Gen]], the reserve team of Juventus.<ref>{{Cite web |date=7 January 2023 |title=Huijsen, arriva la promozione: dalla Primavera alla Next Gen |url=https://tuttosport.com/news/calcio/primavera/2023/01/07-101881235/huijsen_arriva_la_promozione_dalla_primavera_alla_next_gen |access-date=8 January 2023 |website=Tuttosport |language=it-IT}}</ref> He made his professional debut on 8 January, starting in a 2–1 [[2022–23 Serie C|league]] loss against [[Pordenone Calcio|Pordenone]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=9 January 2023 |title=Huijsen, buona la prima nella Juve Next Gen: cosa ha detto Brambilla |url=https://www.tuttosport.com/news/calcio/next-gen/2023/01/09-101977050/huijsen_buona_la_prima_nella_juve_next_gen_cosa_ha_detto_brambilla |access-date=20 May 2025 |website=tuttosport.com |language=it}}</ref> On 15 February, Huijsen scored his first two professional goals in the second leg of a [[Coppa Italia Serie C]] semi-final match against [[Calcio Foggia 1920|Foggia]], helping his team win the tie on [[Penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalties]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=15 February 2023 |title=Huijsen, eroe Next Gen: doppietta e rigore, Foggia ko e Juve in finale |url=https://tuttosport.com/news/calcio/serie-a/juventus/2023/02/15-103645932/huijsen_eroe_next_gen_doppietta_e_rigore_foggia_ko_e_juve_in_finale |access-date=16 February 2023 |website=Tuttosport |language=it-IT}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Agresti |first=Romeo |date=15 February 2023 |title=La Juventus blinda Huijsen: rinnovo di quattro anni |url=https://www.goal.com/it/notizie/la-juventus-blinda-huijsen-rinnovo-di-quattro-anni/bltc40f7fae7347e31c |access-date=16 February 2023 |website=Goal.com}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Zarra |first=Angelo |date=16 February 2023 |title=La notte magica di Huijsen: doppietta al Foggia, Juve Next Gen. in finale di Coppa Italia Serie C |url=https://www.mondoprimavera.com/news/213537689094/la-notte-magica-di-huijsen-doppietta-al-foggia-juve-next-gen-in-finale-di-coppa-italia-serie-c |access-date=16 February 2023 |website=MondoPrimavera |language=it-IT}}</ref> On 2 April, he scored his first goal in [[Serie C]], in a 3–1 home loss to [[Feralpisalò]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2 April 2023 |title=Gol Huijsen: prima rete in Serie C per il difensore della Juventus – VIDEO |url=https://www.juventusnews24.com/gol-huijsen-prima-rete-serie-c-difensore-juventus-next-gen-feralpisalo-campionato-2022-23/ |access-date=2 April 2023 |website=Juventus News 24 |language=it-IT}}</ref>

In June 2023, Huijsen renewed his contract with Juventus until 2027.<ref name=":5" /><ref>{{Cite web |date=16 June 2023 |title=Huijsen, ufficiale il rinnovo con la Juve Next Gen: i dettagli |url=https://tuttosport.com/news/calcio/next-gen/2023/06/16-109140918/huijsen_ufficiale_il_rinnovo_con_la_juve_next_gen_i_dettagli |access-date=17 June 2023 |website=Tuttosport |language=it-IT}}</ref> On 22 October, he made his [[Serie A]] debut, coming off the bench in the 78th minute to replace [[Federico Gatti]] in a 1–0 away win over [[AC Milan]].<ref>{{Cite web |last= |date=3 June 2024 |title=FIRST TEAM DEBUTS THIS SEASON – Juventus |url=https://www.juventus.com/en/news/articles/first-team-debuts-this-season |access-date=31 December 2024 |website=Juventus.com |language=en}}</ref> On 7 November, Juventus announced that Huijsen alongside his Next Gen teammate [[Kenan Yıldız]] had been promoted to the first team.<ref>{{Cite web |last= |date=7 November 2023 |title=Huijsen and Yildiz added to the Juventus First Team |url=https://www.juventus.com/en/news/articles/huijsen-and-yildiz-added-to-the-juventus-first-team |access-date=8 January 2024 |website=[[Juventus FC]] |language=en}}</ref>

====Loan to Roma====
Huijsen was loaned to fellow Italian side [[AS Roma|Roma]] on 6 January 2024 until the end of the 2023–24 season.<ref>{{cite news |date=6 January 2024 |title=Dean Huijsen arrives on loan |url=https://www.asroma.com/en/news/70218/dean-huijsen-arrives-on-loan |access-date=6 January 2024 |publisher=[[AS Roma]]}}</ref> He made his debut with the ''Giallorossi'' the following day, playing the entire second half in a home league draw against [[Atalanta BC|Atalanta]].<ref>{{cite web |title=La Roma scopre un Huijsen di personalità: ottimo il debutto contro l'Atalanta |language=it|url=https://www.goal.com/it/liste/la-roma-scopre-un-huijsen-di-personalita-ottimo-il-debutto-contro-l-atalanta/blte7d22ecd3355b8fd |website=Goal.com |access-date=8 January 2024 |date=7 January 2024}}</ref> In early February, Roma's head coach [[Daniele De Rossi]] excluded him from the team's UEFA list for the [[2024–25 UEFA Europa League knockout phase|Europa League knock-out phase]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=4 February 2024 |title=De Rossi e l'esclusione di Huijsen dalla lista Uefa: "Importantissimo ma..." |url=https://www.tuttosport.com/news/calcio/serie-a/roma/2024/02/04-121686673/de_rossi_e_l_esclusione_di_huijsen_dalla_lista_uefa_importantissimo_ma_ |access-date=17 May 2025 |website=tuttosport.com |language=it}}</ref>

Huijsen scored his first Serie A goal on 5 February, sealing Roma's 4–0 win against [[Cagliari Calcio|Cagliari]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Huijsen, luce Roma: primo gol in Serie A per il classe 2005 |url=http://www.mondoprimavera.com/news/427614965254/huijsen-luce-roma-primo-gol-in-serie-a-per-il-classe-2005 |access-date=7 February 2024 |website=MondoPrimavera |date=6 February 2024 |language=it}}</ref>

===Bournemouth===
On 30 July 2024, Huijsen was signed from Juventus by [[Premier League]] club [[AFC Bournemouth|Bournemouth]] on a six-year deal, for an initial fee of €15.2 million, which could rise to €18.2 million.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.afcb.co.uk/news/2024/july/30/cherries-complete-signing-of-young-defender-huijsen-/|title=Cherries complete signing of young defender Huijsen|publisher=AFC Bournemouth|date=30 July 2024|access-date=30 July 2024}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/cg649w1yw4go|title=Dean Huijsen: Bournemouth sign teenage defender for £12.8m from Juventus|date=30 July 2024|website=BBC Sport}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=30 July 2024 |title=AGREEMENT WITH BOURNEMOUTH FOR THE DEFINITIVE DISPOSAL OF THE PLAYER HUIJSEN |url=https://www.juventus.com/images/image/private/fl_attachment/dev/aspn2vl928kvoua7req8.pdf |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240914115851/https://www.juventus.com/images/image/private/fl_attachment/dev/aspn2vl928kvoua7req8.pdf |archive-date=14 September 2024 |access-date=31 December 2024 |website=Juventus FC}}</ref> He made his debut for the ''Cherries'' on 17 August in a 1–1 draw against [[Nottingham Forest F.C.|Nottingham Forest]], and won nine aerial duels.<ref>{{Cite web |date=21 August 2024 |title=Bournemouth news: Opinion – Dean Huijsen shines on debut but goalkeeper debate resurfaces |url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/cx2e959d705o |access-date=17 May 2025 |website=BBC Sport |language=en-GB}}</ref> On 5 December 2024, he scored his first goal for the club, with a header in a 1–0 home win over [[Tottenham Hotspur F.C.|Tottenham Hotspur]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Bournemouth 1–0 Tottenham Dean Huijsen header gives Cherries victory |url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/live/cjr2dnddj8qt |access-date=5 December 2024 |website=BBC Sport |language=en-GB}}</ref> He thus became the youngest-ever goalscorer for the club in the Premier League.<ref>{{Cite web |last= |first= |date=5 December 2024 |title=Dean Huijsen heads Bournemouth ahead to break a club record |url=https://sports.yahoo.com/dean-huijsen-heads-bournemouth-ahead-204300881.html |access-date=5 December 2024 |website= |publisher=[[Yahoo Sports]] |language=en-GB}}</ref>

On 19 June 2025, it was announced that Huijsen was one of six nominees for the PFA Young Player of the Year award for his performances in the previous season with Bournemouth.<ref>{{Cite web |date=19 June 2025 |title=PFA Young Player of the Year nominees announced |url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cj4edzw9qxeo |access-date=19 June 2025 |publisher=BBC Sport |language=en-GB}}</ref>

===Real Madrid===
On 17 May 2025, [[La Liga]] club [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]] announced the signing of Huijsen, with the player joining ''Los Blancos'' on a contract until July 2030.<ref>{{Cite web |date=17 May 2025 |title=Official Statement: Huijsen |url=https://www.realmadrid.com/en-US/news/football/first-team/latest-news/comunicado-oficial-huijsen-17-05-2025 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250517103248/https://www.realmadrid.com/en-US/news/football/first-team/latest-news/comunicado-oficial-huijsen-17-05-2025 |archive-date=17 May 2025 |access-date=17 May 2025 |publisher=[[Real Madrid CF]]}}</ref><ref name=":7">{{Cite web |date=17 May 2025 |title=Huijsen, new Real Madrid player |url=https://www.realmadrid.com/en-US/news/football/first-team/latest-news/huijsen-nuevo-jugador-del-real-madrid-17-05-2025 |access-date=17 May 2025 |website= |publisher=Real Madrid CF}}</ref> The deal was worth £50&nbsp;million (€59.5&nbsp;million), with Madrid triggering his release clause.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.afcb.co.uk/news/2025/may/17/huijsen-to-move-to-real-madrid-at-end-of-season/ |title=Huijsen to join Real Madrid at end of season |publisher=AFC Bournemouth |date=17 May 2025|access-date=17 May 2025}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Begley |first=Emlyn |date=17 May 2025 |title=Dean Huijsen to Real Madrid: How Bournemouth defender became one of Europe's most coveted. |url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/cq85kz5vngno |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250519153822/https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/cq85kz5vngno |archive-date=19 May 2025 |access-date=17 May 2025 |website= |publisher=BBC Sport |language=en-GB}}</ref> He was officially presented as a Real Madrid player on 9 June,<ref>{{Cite web |date=9 June 2025 |title=Huijsen presented as new Real Madrid player |url=https://www.realmadrid.com/en-US/news/football/first-team/latest-news/huijsen-presentado-como-nuevo-jugador-del-real-madrid-10-06-2025 |access-date=10 June 2025 |publisher=Real Madrid CF}}</ref> receiving the number 24 shirt.<ref>{{Cite web |date=9 June 2025 |title=Huijsen signs his contract with Real Madrid |url=https://www.realmadrid.com/en-US/news/football/first-team/latest-news/huijsen-firmo-su-contrato-con-el-real-madrid-10-06-2025 |access-date=10 June 2025 |publisher=Real Madrid CF}}</ref>

Huijsen made his debut for the club at the [[2025 FIFA Club World Cup]] in a [[2025 FIFA Club World Cup Group H|group stage]] match against [[Al-Hilal Saudi FC|Al-Hilal]] on 18 June, which resulted in a 1–1 draw.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Astbury |first=Matt |date=18 June 2025 |title=Al-Hilal hold Real Madrid to 1-1 draw in Group H opener |url=https://www.dazn.com/en-US/news/soccer/al-hilal-vs-real-madrid-highlights-fifa-club-world-cup-cwc25uk/4eq7jgd2u18710o7h84kenv9f |access-date=18 June 2025 |publisher=[[DAZN]]}}</ref> He made his [[La Liga]] debut for Madrid on 19 August 2025, in a 1–0 victory over [[CA Osasuna|Osasuna]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=14 August 2025 |title=Real Madrid 1–0 Osasuna: Mbappe penalty gives Alonso unconvincing win|url=https://www.fotmob.com/de/news/1i5wg7hruqaid1u0kv2calu9j5-real-madrid-1-0-osasuna-mbappe-penalty-gives-alonso-unconvincing-win|access-date=19 August 2025 |publisher=fotmob.com}}</ref>

In February 2026, Huijsen faced allegations of racism after he reposted an image on Instagram containing derogatory comments mocking the eye shape of Asian people.<ref name=":9">{{Cite web |date=23 February 2026 |title=Real Madrid's Dean Huijsen apologises on Chinese app for offensive post |url=https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/48013184/real-madrid-dean-huijsen-apologises-weibo-chinese-friends |website=ESPN |access-date=24 February 2026}}</ref><ref name=":10">{{Cite web |date=23 February 2026 |title=Instagram repost lands Real Madrid defender in hot water in China |url=https://en.as.com/soccer/instagram-repost-lands-real-madrid-defender-in-hot-water-in-china-f202602-n/ |website=AS |language=en |access-date=24 February 2026 }}</ref> Real Madrid published an apology attributed to the player on the club's official [[Weibo]] account.<ref name=":9" /><ref name=":10" />

==International career==
===Netherlands===
Huijsen represented the Netherlands at various youth international levels, playing for the [[Netherlands national under-17 football team|under-17]] and [[Netherlands national under-19 football team|under-19]] national teams.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Rossi |first=Marco |date=16 March 2022 |title=Juventus, Huijsen è un gigante. E ha il vizio del gol |url=https://torino.corriere.it/calcio-giovanile/nazionali/22_marzo_16/juventus-huijsen-gigante-ha-vizio-gol-5450f1ee-a546-11ec-8f73-d81a6d7583fb.shtml |access-date=7 January 2023 |website=Corriere della Sera |language=it-IT}}</ref>

In May 2022, Huijsen was included in the Dutch under-17 squad that took part in the [[2022 UEFA European Under-17 Championship|UEFA European Under-17 Championship]] in Israel,<ref name=":3" /><ref>{{Cite web |date=6 May 2022 |title=Definitieve selectie Onder 17 voor EK in Israël |url=https://www.onsoranje.nl/nieuws/jeugd-mannen-onder-17/80165/definitieve-selectie-onder-17-voor-ek-israël |access-date=8 January 2023 |website=[[Royal Dutch Football Association]] |language=nl}}</ref> where he scored two [[Penalty kick (association football)|penalties]] in the group stage matches against [[France national under-17 football team|France]] and [[Poland national under-17 football team|Poland]],<ref>{{Cite web |title=Privacyinstellingen op VI.nl |url=https://www.vi.nl/cookies/;jsessionid=FBE7148556C572C2D1BC0455A001D92A |access-date=7 January 2023 |website=vi.nl}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=22 May 2022 |title=Oranje onder 17 van Groninger bondscoach als groepswinnaar naar kwartfinale EK |url=https://www.rtvnoord.nl/nieuws/925266/oranje-onder-17-van-groninger-bondscoach-als-groepswinnaar-naar-kwartfinale-ek |access-date=7 January 2023 |website=rtvnoord.nl |language=nl}}</ref> as ''Oranje'' eventually finished as runners-up after losing to France in the final.<ref name=":4">{{Cite web |date=1 June 2022 |title=France 2–1 Netherlands: French fight back to claim third U17 EURO title after Kumbedi double |url=https://www.uefa.com/under17/news/0276-154917d1cf84-f4fc7aa49b21-1000--france-2-1-netherlands-french-fight-back-to-claim-third-u17-eur/ |access-date=8 January 2023 |publisher=[[UEFA]] |language=en}}</ref>

===Spain===
On 15 March 2024, Huijsen was called up by the [[Spain national under-21 football team|Spain national under-21 team]] to play the [[2025 UEFA European Under-21 Championship qualification Group B]] match against [[Belgium national under-21 football team|Belgium]]. twelve months later,<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://rfef.es/es/noticias/oficial-convocatoria-para-los-partidos-frente-eslovaquia-y-belgica|title=OFICIAL &#124; Convocatoria para los partidos frente a Eslovaquia y Bélgica|publisher=Royal Spanish Football Federation |work=rfef.es}}</ref> On 17 March 2025, he was called up by the [[Spain national football team|senior side]] for the [[2024–25 UEFA Nations League#Quarter-finals|Nations League quarter-finals]] against the [[Netherlands national football team|Netherlands]].<ref name="20min">{{Cite web|website=[[20minutos.es]]|access-date=18 March 2025|language=es|url=https://www.20minutos.es/deportes/noticia/5691596/0/inigo-martinez-baja-por-lesion-lista-espana-le-sustituye-dean-huijsen/|title=Iñigo Martínez y Marc Casadó, bajas de la lista de España por lesión: De la Fuente llama a Dean Huijsen y Aleix García|date=17 March 2025 }}</ref> He was covering [[Iñigo Martínez]]'s absence due to injury<ref name="20min" /> and made his debut coming on in the 41st minute, replacing [[Pau Cubarsí]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=20 March 2025 |title=Barcelona star Pau Cubarsi suffers injury blow on Spain duty |url=https://sports.yahoo.com/article/barcelona-star-pau-cubarsi-suffers-232600198.html |access-date=21 March 2025 |website=Yahoo Sports }}</ref> The match ended 2–2, Huijsen was one of Spain's best players and received a hostile reception from home fans in the [[De Kuip|Stadion Feijenoord]] for switching nations in order to play for Spain.<ref>{{Cite web |date=20 March 2025 |title=Spain defender Huijsen gets hostile reception in Rotterdam |url=https://www.reuters.com/sports/soccer/spain-defender-huijsen-gets-hostile-reception-rotterdam-2025-03-20/ |website=Reuters}}</ref> He called his debut a "dream".<ref>{{Cite web |last=Teledeporte |first=RTVE |date=20 March 2025 |title=Dean Huijsen, feliz por el debut con la selección española (SEFutbol) y por hacerlo contra Países Bajos, donde tiene sus raíces |url=https://x.com/teledeporte/status/1902842474273407348 |website=X.com}}</ref> Huijsen started the second leg and was praised for an assist in additional [[Overtime (sports)#Association football|extra time]] which [[Lamine Yamal]] scored from.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Church |first=Ben |date=24 March 2025 |title=Teenager Lamine Yamal scores wonder goal, misses penalty and mocks pundit in dramatic Spain win |url=https://www.cnn.com/2025/03/24/sport/lamine-yamal-win-nations-league-spt-intl/index.html |access-date=25 March 2025 |website=CNN }}</ref> He was left out of the Spain squad that won the [[2026 FIFA World Cup]].<ref>{{cite news |title=World Cup 2026: Spain squad includes Lamine Yamal but no Real Madrid players |url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/crlpp3dw14lo |access-date=25 May 2026 |work=[[BBC Sport]] |date=25 May 2026}}</ref>

==Style of play==
Huijsen is a physical 1.96 m-tall centre-back.<ref>{{Cite web |date=22 December 2022 |title=Huijsen, il baby talento della Juve che fa il suo esordio contro il Rijeka |url=https://www.tuttosport.com/news/calcio/serie-a/juventus/2022/12/22-81405887/huijsen_il_baby_talento_della_juve_che_fa_il_suo_esordio_contro_il_rijeka |access-date=2 June 2025|website=www.tuttosport.com |language=it}}</ref> He is mainly right-footed but can also use his left foot.<ref name=":6">{{Cite web |date=22 December 2022|title=Dean Huijsen in campo contro il Rijeka: il baby difensore della Juventus convince {{!}} Goal.com Italia |url=https://www.goal.com/it/notizie/dean-huijsen-juventus-difensore-olanda/blt62686a3524931b4e |access-date=2 June 2025 |website=www.goal.com |language=it}}</ref> He has an eye for the goal and can also take penalty kicks, making him a ball-playing defender who can build up attacks.<ref name=":6" />
